description: This PHP source file defines the CalendarViewCreateInvitee class, which manages the creation of invitee entries in the Calendar module of the SuiteCRM software. It handles permission checks, initializes relevant beans (Leads or Contacts), and outputs JSON data representing the created invitee.

classes.name: CalendarViewCreateInvitee
classes.description: Class responsible for creating invitees in the calendar, handling permission verification, and returning invitee data as JSON.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Prepares the view by verifying permissions, instantiating the invitee bean (Lead or Contact), and saving if permitted.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Outputs the invitee data as a JSON object, including the selected fields.

methods.name: returnNoAccess
methods.description: Outputs a JSON object indicating no access and terminates the script.
